cumleler: Is there a case where masking simply cannot work?
With conductive components in both ears, masking can reach a dead end.
A conductive block in the other ear raises the minimum noise.
Good bone conduction in the test ear lowers the maximum noise.
Once the minimum exceeds the maximum, no plateau window remains.
This is the masking dilemma; the first step is insert earphones.
